description: Searches the Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA and USDA mortgage guidelines and returns the most relevant verbatim passages. Each passage includes the document, version date, page, a ready-made citation (cite_as), the official source link and a citation URL on zeitro.com. A focused question per call (for example 'FHA student loan monthly payment calculation') returns the best passages. Passages may contain HTML tables. Lender overlays are not included.

lenders.description: Restrict to these agencies: 'Fannie Mae', 'Freddie Mac', 'FHA', 'VA', 'USDA'. Lender names are accepted but their guidelines are not in the free tier.
